name: Tartrazine
aliases: E102, tartrazine, FD&C Yellow No. 5, Yellow 5, CI 19140, CI Food Yellow 4, Acid Yellow 23, Food Yellow 4
what_is: A synthetic yellow azo colour used to add or restore colour in foods and known in the United States as FD&C Yellow No. 5.
why_botia: BOTIA flags tartrazine because, in a small number of sensitive people, it can trigger reactions such as hives or asthma, particularly in people who are also sensitive to aspirin. Sensitivity reactions to food additives such as colourings and preservatives are reported more frequently in adult women, which is why tartrazine also activates the Woman layer. In the EU, foods containing tartrazine must also carry a warning that it may have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children.
can_1: Identify E102, tartrazine, FD&C Yellow No. 5 or common label synonyms.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and Woman information layers without inferring a sex-specific effect from the ingredient name alone.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration used unless it is declared or supplied by the manufacturer.
cannot_2: Predict individual sensitivity or conclude that the ingredient causes a health effect in a specific person.
